research_notes_other.notes_from_film_list.txt: Investigation into the controversial conviction that was later overturned due to prosecutorial misconduct, though Temple was later reconvicted at a new trial. Available via CBS/Paramount+.
research_notes_other.research_findings: While searches didn't confirm a 48 Hours episode titled "Reasonable Doubt" specifically about David Temple, the details in the list entry accurately reflect his well-known case involving the murder of his wife, an overturned conviction due to prosecutorial misconduct (withholding evidence), and a subsequent reconviction in a later trial.

featured_individuals.time_served: Served ~9 years before first conviction overturned; currently incarcerated since 2019 reconviction.
contributing_factors_raw: Alleged prosecutorial misconduct (withholding favorable evidence - *Brady* violation) led to first conviction being overturned; circumstantial evidence debated across trials.
featured_individuals.status_raw: Currently incarcerated serving life sentence after 2019 reconviction.
